name: Tallycairn
subtitle: Score card and dice nights
shortDescription: Put the pencil down. Tallycairn tallies every hand, calls the dealer, spots slips in the arithmetic and remembers who won the night.
longDescription:
Game night should be about the table, not the arithmetic. Tallycairn is the scorekeeper that sits beside the cards and does the sums.

Pick a game, add the players, and enter each round with big thumb-sized keys. Totals, who is ahead, who deals next and roughly how many hands are left update the moment you save. A gentle check box points out entries that cannot be right, such as hearts that add up to 14, but it never changes your numbers behind your back.

### What It Keeps Score For
- Hearts: penalty points, the queen of spades, shooting the moon, first to the limit loses.
- Spades: partner teams, bids, nils, bags and the ten-bag penalty.
- Cribbage: a pegging board that moves as you score, with skunk and double-skunk results.
- Rummy points race: one winner per deal, losers add their hand, play to your target.
- Five dice: a full thirteen-line sheet with the upper bonus and extra five-alike counter.
- Card golf: lowest total wins over the rounds you choose.
- Bid and tricks: contract-style scoring for the family games that do not fit anywhere else.
- Your own game: set the target, direction and fields once, and keep it for next time.

### Made for One Hand
Tap a cell, tap the keys, press Next. Or tap the microphone and say "Maya twelve, Theo eight". Speech is turned into numbers on your device and is not sent anywhere.

### A Night, Not Just a Game
Every finished game lands in Nights, with who took the evening. People shows wins, best totals and head-to-head records for the regulars. Share a clean recap card in one tap, or press Rematch to deal the same table again.

### Plain Words, No Account
Short rule cards for each game live inside the app, with public sources listed. There is no sign-in, nothing to sync and nothing leaves your phone except what the ads below need.

BUILT FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
On iPad the board and the round-by-round table sit side by side, and Two boards lets you run a second game at the same time.

### Tallycairn Is Free
Tallycairn only keeps score. It does not deal cards, play against you or involve any money, and it is not affiliated with any game publisher or brand.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
